answer.reason: The verses foretell Gog's coming against Israel and his defeat, which the summary does not give beyond his burial.

clauses.english: was brought by God against the land of Israel in the latter days
clauses.quote: I will bring thee against my land

clauses.english: was turned back by God and left with only a sixth part of his host
clauses.quote: I will turn thee back, and leave but the sixth part of thee

doubts: All the events are foretold by the LORD through Ezekiel as future, and are written here as events of the record. His burial is left out because the summary already gives it.
